item.title: How Benjamin Netanyahu reshaped Israel’s institutions
item.description: As Israel heads to the polls on October 27, its polarising and longest-serving prime minister is seeking re-election.

item.title: Hospital in Yemen’s Taiz warns of collapse in days because of Houthi siege
item.description: Dialysis patients face shorter treatment sessions as severe shortages of fuel, medicines, and oxygen threaten hospitals.

item.title: Lebanese sceptical Israeli polls will bring change, end occupation of south
item.description: Residents and analysts doubt October 27 vote will bring any meaningful shift in Israeli policy towards their country.

item.title: Massive oil slick seen weeks after tanker struck off UAE’s coast
item.description: An oil spill off the UAE coast has prompted beach closures after a vessel reportedly hit a naval mine in early October.

item.title: Argentina identifies dozens of victims killed in its ‘Dirty War’
item.description: Forensic anthropologists have identified the remains of at least 38 victims of Argentina’s last military dictatorship.

item.title: Marco Rubio urges Cubans to collaborate with CIA to topple gov’t
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio has urged Cubans to secretly work with the CIA to topple their government.

item.title: Israel raids towns, detains dozens of Palestinians in occupied West Bank
item.description: Israeli military raid targets at least 15 towns in the northern West Bank, including Nablus and Jenin.

item.title: Pentagon designates Confucius Institutes a national security threat
item.description: Pete Hegseth says the Pentagon dismantled 80 ‘propaganda cells’ operating under new names at 30 universities.

item.title: Century-old mosque near Indian PM’s residence under gov’t threat
item.description: India’s Muslims fear the demolition of a historic mosque near PM's house after the imam claimed he got eviction notice.

item.title: Argentinian judge drops fraud investigation into Milei over crypto scandal
item.description: President Javier Milei’s role in cryptocurrency launch does not translate into a fraudulent scheme, judge says.

item.title: Syrians protest Israel’s incursions near occupied Golan Heights
item.description: Syrians are protesting Israel’s occupation of parts of the country’s south, near the occupied Golan Heights.

item.title: WHO announces start of Ebola vaccine clinical trial in DR Congo
item.description: A clinical trial begins to test the safety, efficacy and immunogenicity of multiple vaccines.

item.title: Iran war live: Saudi Arabia downs Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh
item.description: Saudi-led coalition says air defences downed a Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh.

item.title: Macklemore: ‘I say free Palestine’ as he kicks off a new tour
item.description: Macklemore says ‘being human is not complicated’ as he kicked off his Free Palestine tour on Thursday night.

item.title: Typhoon Champi hits Taiwan, killing one and injuring hundreds
item.description: Storm topples trees, triggers brief flooding, disrupts power lines and forces 5,000 people to evacuate.

item.title: Kenya announces second Ebola death, says ‘no evidence’ of community spread
item.description: The Ebola outbreak has now spread to four countries across eastern, central ⁠⁠and western Africa.

item.title: Why is Israel increasing its presence in the Balkans?
item.description: In the Balkans, leaders are deepening ties with Israel through defence, surveillance, and political backing. But why?

item.title: Masked gunmen kill seven in attack on church funeral in Jordan
item.description: At least seven people were killed and 34 wounded after two masked gunmen opened fire at a church in Karak, Jordan.

item.title: ‘Generation Right’: Israeli youth show strong support for the right
item.description: Some three quarters of Jewish first-time voters identify as right or centre-right, higher than rest of Israeli society.

item.title: FCC Democrat warns broadcasters to resist Trump’s media pressure tactics
item.description: Democrat Anna Gomez warns broadcasters against yielding to the Trump-era FCC's claims of fake polls and news distortions.

item.title: Time ‘running out’ to reach Yemen’s Taiz amid deepening crisis, UN says
item.description: More than 800,000 people have been cut off from aid since the Houthis encircled Taiz city in early October.

item.title: Why is the UK at the forefront of AI-driven job cuts?
item.description: AI-linked job losses in the UK are running at twice the rate of US and Germany.

item.title: Why is Trump questioning Ilhan Omar’s name?
item.description: A Justice Department filing listed a different name for her, prompting Trump to call for her resignation.

item.title: Russia, Ukraine agree to Melania Trump-brokered localised ceasefire
item.description: President Trump says it was First Lady Melania Trump’s initiative that led to a ceasefire in Oleshky.

item.title: Trump’s broken promises: economy, war and ICE
item.description: Mehdi Hasan debates ex-Trump adviser Steve Cortes on the economy, Trump’s immigration policies and Islamophobia.
